sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 2 June 2026, pitch SYN-SYNCP000134-P1 was put before Desert Bloom Family Clinic 134 on behalf of SANOFI.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 1 rebate of 2 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly DTaP minimum take of 460 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer turned the terms down.
